ticket.subject: Suspicious sign-in and new API key
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

Writing on behalf of Glimmerbrook BV. We got sign-in alerts from a country where nobody at Glimmerbrook BV works, and a new API key was created on our admin account that none of us made.

We have changed the admin password, but we are not sure the other sessions were ended. The audit log shows the new keys were used a few minutes later.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Can your team investigate and lock this down with us?

Many thanks,
Nikhil Okonkwo
support lead, Glimmerbrook BV

label_notes: clean access (access-suspicious-login): a suspected security incident is P1 in the guide; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
